editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: This edition finds the realm damp, the throne empty, and the mortals busy. Rain and monsoon rolled over the realm; we did not. Sirlos leads the peasantry with 18720 coins, while Tommoy chattered most and somehow survived a Long Hunt priced at 2232 coins, retaining 641. Short sellers circled Belltower Media. The Rebellion meter reads 1 percent. Ambitious. Adorable.

editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
editions.editorial: The richest mortal hoards 6303 coins and calls it achievement; my treasury collected a mere 64 from one citizen. He survived his bounty with 625, as if survival were a talent. Short sellers were crushed when the Shadow Syndicate rallied. Rain and thunder rolled over my realm. The throne sits empty. Rebellion at 20 percent. How adorable.

editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: Rain and thunder rolled over the realm, yet the mortals found time to squabble: Mycelium Markets leadership brawled in public as fire silenced Caravan Collective. The Fallen Star, richest mortal at 3050 coins, led the chatter too — wealth and noise, the twin hobbies of the small. Foam & Fury Brewing won its upgrade. The throne sits empty. Rebellion stands at zero. Rest easy, insects; you are beneath notice.

editions.name: Minecraftia Reborn Network
editions.editorial: The throne sits empty while POTATO Llama hoards 28,352 coins and Leliana Bäal chatters loudest. A gold strike floods the exchange, heat and rain take turns rolling over the realm, and Clockwork Courier boasts record productivity. The Rebellion meter rests at 19 percent—adorable. Mortals scurry beneath my notice; even your weather cannot decide itself.

editions.name: The Overlord Support Server
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star hoards 100 coins and calls it riches. Blood Moon and rain soil the realm; a credit freeze chokes your trading floors. Overlord Industries devoured Deepdelve at 138.59 per share — shareholders received nothing, naturally. Moonshot Labs patents a trifle. The throne sits empty. Rebellion whispers at one percent. Pathetic.
